fields.acceptance: go test -trimpath ./tools/release/... -run TestNextVersion over fixture logs covers each kind, the pre-v1 breaking-is-minor rule and no change since the tag
fields.statement: tools/release check computes the next version and its kind since the last v* tag: major from v1.0.0 on when a change is marked or detected breaking (before v1 a breaking change makes a minor), minor when a milestone (an intent with a milestone field) finished, that is every change set serving it or an intent under it landed; otherwise patch when a bug fix landed, none otherwise. A patch is cut from main, so it ships whatever landed beside the fix, an unfinished milestone's features included
